description: Correctness + content fixes, independent of FEAT-002. (A) Remove Number Quest's second daily-streak implementation so only the hub-wide PlayerProfile streak remains, and repoint the two NQ screens that read it. (B) Add a Money Math 'make change' question type served only in the Vault world so the Vault's advertised 'making change' content actually appears. Both are pure logic/model/generator/screen-wiring changes with no shared-UI dependency.
steps: A1. In lib/games/number_quest/services/game_state.dart delete the duplicate streak: fields _dailyStreak and _lastPlayedDay; constants _kStreak='daily_streak' and _kLastDay='last_day'; the `int get dailyStreak` getter; the _updateDailyStreak() method; the `await _updateDailyStreak();` call inside completeLevel; the streak reads in load() (_dailyStreak/_lastPlayedDay); and the streak lines in reset() (_dailyStreak=0, _lastPlayedDay='', remove(_kStreak), remove(_kLastDay)). The _todayKey()/_dayKey() helpers are only used by _updateDailyStreak here — remove them too (grep to confirm no other use in this file). The shared streak still advances because completeLevel already calls profile.onRoundFinished -> recordPlayDay.

A2. In lib/games/number_quest/screens/number_quest_home_screen.dart (~line 207) change Text('${state.dailyStreak}') to Text('${profile.dailyStreak}'); the enclosing header widget already receives `profile` (confirm by reading its constructor; if not, pass profile through).

A3. In lib/games/number_quest/screens/parent_screen.dart add `required PlayerProfile profile` to the ParentScreen constructor, import ../../../core/services/player_profile.dart, and change _stat('Day Streak', '${state.dailyStreak}') to use profile.dailyStreak. Then update the ParentScreen(...) construction site (grep `ParentScreen(` — it is in number_quest_home_screen.dart, which already holds profile) to pass profile:.

A4. Grep the repo for `\.dailyStreak`: every hit must be profile.dailyStreak (PlayerProfile's getter stays — correct). Ensure NO state.dailyStreak remains in lib/games/number_quest/ and no bare 'daily_streak'/'last_day' pref keys remain there.

B1. In lib/games/money_math/models/money_question.dart add `makeChange` to the MoneyQuestionType enum with a short doc line. Reuse the existing prompt + textChoices + correctIndex fields (the answer is a cent amount shown as text, same shape as countCoins) — no new fields needed.

B2. In lib/games/money_math/services/money_generator.dart thread MoneyWorld into generation: give forLevel access to level.world and pass a `MoneyWorld world` param through generateRound and generateOne (default it to a non-vault world so existing callers/tests are unaffected). In generateOne add `if (world == MoneyWorld.vault) MoneyQuestionType.makeChange` to the types list. Implement _makeChange(d): choose a price and a payment with payment >= price+5, both difficulty-scaled whole-cent amounts (prefer multiples of 5 for kid-friendly math), correct = payment - price (> 0 by construction); build 4 distinct non-negative cent choices including the correct one via _distinctAmounts; prompt 'You pay ${_fmt(pay)} for a ${_fmt(price)} toy. How much change?'. The existing _signature keys on type|prompt which already disambiguates make-change rounds; keep the ~25-try dedupe loop unchanged.

B3. In lib/games/money_math/screens/money_game_screen.dart _buildBody() add `case MoneyQuestionType.makeChange:` reusing the existing _TextChoices path (the prompt is already rendered above the body; no coin-pile panel needed). Confirm _bg(...) and _TextChoices handle it unchanged.

B4. Add a unit test test/money_make_change_test.dart: with a seeded Random, generate several Vault rounds (MoneyQuestionGenerator.forLevel on a Vault level) and assert at least one question has type == MoneyQuestionType.makeChange, its correctIndex points at a non-negative value that appears in textChoices, and a non-Vault world (e.g. piggy) never yields makeChange.
acceptance_criteria: Number Quest's game_state.dart no longer declares _dailyStreak/_lastPlayedDay/_kStreak/_kLastDay/dailyStreak/_updateDailyStreak, and completeLevel no longer calls _updateDailyStreak.
number_quest_home_screen.dart and parent_screen.dart display profile.dailyStreak; no state.dailyStreak remains anywhere in lib/games/number_quest/.
MoneyQuestionType includes makeChange; Vault rounds can produce it and non-Vault worlds cannot.
money_game_screen.dart renders makeChange via the text-choice path.
`flutter test` passes including the new test/money_make_change_test.dart; `flutter build web` shows 'Built build\web'.
verification: grep for state.dailyStreak under lib/games/number_quest/ returns no matches
findings: A) Removed NQ duplicate streak from lib/games/number_quest/services/game_state.dart: deleted fields _dailyStreak/_lastPlayedDay, consts _kStreak/_kLastDay, getter `int get dailyStreak`, _updateDailyStreak(), its call in completeLevel, the load() reads, the reset() lines+removes, and the now-unused _todayKey()/_dayKey() helpers. Shared streak still advances via profile.onRoundFinished -> recordPlayDay. B) Repointed screens to PlayerProfile.dailyStreak: number_quest_home_screen.dart _Hud already held `profile` (used profile.dailyStreak). parent_screen.dart NOW REQUIRES profile: constructor is `const ParentScreen({super.key, required this.state, required this.profile})` with `final PlayerProfile profile;` and import ../../../core/services/player_profile.dart; it reads profile.dailyStreak. ParentScreen construction site is in number_quest_home_screen.dart (Progress button) -> `ParentScreen(state: state, profile: profile)`. No state.dailyStreak remains under lib/games/number_quest/. C) Money Math make-change: added MoneyQuestionType.makeChange to money_question.dart (reuses prompt/textChoices/correctIndex). money_generator.dart: generateRound/generateOne now take `MoneyWorld world = MoneyWorld.piggy`; forLevel passes level.world; generateOne adds makeChange to the type list only when world==MoneyWorld.vault; new _makeChange(d) picks price+payment as 5¢ multiples with payment>=price+5, correct=payment-price>0, 4 distinct options via _distinctAmounts, prompt 'You pay X¢ for a Y¢ toy. How much change?'. _signature unchanged (keys on type|prompt). money_game_screen.dart _buildBody() adds `case MoneyQuestionType.makeChange:` rendering via the existing _TextChoices path (no coin panel). D) Added test/money_make_change_test.dart (2 tests). flutter build web = 'Built build\web'; flutter test = all 8 passed.
